This site summarizes an analysis of how GLI-mediated Hedgehog signaling relates
to neurodevelopmental-disorder genes. GLI is overexpressed in neuronal
progenitors and then perturbed or removed, and gene expression is measured over
time. Responsive genes were grouped into 10 clusters with maSigPro.

We test whether these clusters are enriched for genes implicated in autism
(SFARI, TADA) and in neurodevelopmental disorders more broadly (NDD).
Schizophrenia (MAGMA with GWAS) is planned.
